text: Reference image: user-supplied Screen Recording 2026-09-28 082043.mp4, near 24 seconds. WeatherEx.ai/Cumulus demonstrates a question typed in Malayalam using Latin characters: "kochiyil nale mazha peyyumo?", meaning approximately "Will it rain in Kochi tomorrow?" The assistant responds in Malayalam script and offers follow-up questions. Forecast, trip-planning, extended-forecast and comparison prompts are visible suggestions, not independently verified response capabilities. Sign-in is demonstrated, but its personal details are excluded from this deck.

text: Conceptual architecture proposed for Weather GPT, not an architecture verified from the screen recordings. The core data flow uses an external weather-data service and an assistant that retrieves location-specific readings before composing an answer. The reference Weather Globe attributes data to Open-Meteo, but the team must confirm its actual provider, application stack and model before claiming an implementation. Data timestamps and units are proposed requirements.
